notice: Source strategy for the Public Data Catalog. No source is queried in M0. Terms entries summarise what must be reviewed; they are not legal conclusions and every source's current terms must be re-read and snapshotted before its records advance past CATALOGUED.
deduplication_rules: INSDC archives (NCBI SRA, ENA, DDBJ DRA) exchange records; a run mirrored across archives is ONE dataset keyed by its run accession, never three.
The accession prefix (SRR/ERR/DRR, SRX/ERX/DRX, SRP/ERP/DRP, SAMN/SAMEA/SAMD, PRJNA/PRJEB/PRJDB) records the originating archive; it does not create a separate dataset.
Sample identity is keyed on BioSample accession; cell-line and repository aliases (e.g. HG002 / NA24385 / GM24385) are resolved to one sample via an alias table with provenance.
Benchmark-resource records (GIAB, precisionFDA) that point to INSDC runs are linked to the INSDC run record, not counted as additional datasets.
Derived artifacts (VCF, BAM, CRAM) are distinct entities linked to the run(s) they derive from; a derived artifact never increases the dataset count of its source run.

mirror_groups.label: International Nucleotide Sequence Database Collaboration
mirror_groups.independent_count_rule: count distinct run_accession across all members

sources.label: NCBI Sequence Read Archive
sources.deduplication_strategy: Key on run_accession within the INSDC mirror group; record suppression status; never count mirrors.
sources.terms_review: INSDC/NCBI public-data policies; submitter-imposed restrictions must be checked. Controlled-access (dbGaP) data is out of scope.
sources.evidence_grade_note: Raw-read metadata alone is not evidence; a run becomes evidence-relevant only when linked to a truth/comparator relationship and a frozen protocol.

sources.label: European Nucleotide Archive
contributes: FASTQ/submitted-file URLs with MD5 and byte sizes
sources.deduplication_strategy: Same run_accession key as ncbi_sra; ENA may be preferred for file-level checksums, but contributes no additional dataset count.
sources.terms_review: EMBL-EBI terms of use; INSDC policies.

sources.label: NCBI BioProject
sources.deduplication_strategy: Count studies at the leaf project level; umbrella links are relationships, not datasets.

sources.label: NCBI BioSample
duplication_risks: one biological source registered as several BioSamples
sources.deduplication_strategy: BioSample accession is the sample key; biological-source equivalence across BioSamples requires an alias table with provenance and is never inferred by ML alone.

sources.label: NCBI Taxonomy
sources.deduplication_strategy: Resolve merged IDs to the current ID while retaining the source-reported ID.

sources.label: NCBI Datasets / Assembly
duplication_risks: GCA vs GCF accessions for the same assembly
sources.deduplication_strategy: Pair GCA/GCF explicitly; treat each accession version as distinct.

sources.label: Genome in a Bottle (NIST)
contributes: benchmark truth VCFs and BEDs by sample, version and assembly
indexes of public sequencing data for GIAB samples
duplication_risks: sequencing data indexed by GIAB also present in INSDC
same truth set mirrored on several hosts
sources.deduplication_strategy: Truth sets keyed by (sample, release version, assembly, file checksum); sequencing data keyed by INSDC run accession where one exists.
sources.terms_review: NIST data terms as recorded in v1 source_artifacts.tsv; re-verify per release.

sources.label: precisionFDA Truth Challenge V2 (NIST PDR mds2-2336)
contributes: public submission VCFs with publisher checksums
sources.deduplication_strategy: Key on (submission_id, sample_id); records already in v1.0.0 are referenced, never re-added as new.

sources.label: Sequencing-vendor public benchmark datasets (e.g. ONT Open Data, PacBio and Illumina public datasets)
contributes: run-level files and sometimes VCFs for reference samples
chemistry and basecaller detail often richer than INSDC
duplication_risks: same data also deposited in INSDC
re-basecalled versions of the same raw signal
sources.deduplication_strategy: Link to INSDC accession when present; treat re-basecalled outputs as derived artifacts of the same raw data, not new datasets.
sources.terms_review: Each vendor's dataset licence must be read and snapshotted; vendor-produced data carries a conflict-of-interest flag for any comparative use.

sources.label: Europe PMC / PubMed
duplication_risks: preprint and journal versions of one study
sources.deduplication_strategy: Key on DOI; link preprint and published versions explicitly.
sources.terms_review: Metadata only; full text is not redistributed.
